messages.author: 1004dd6f66bb10c3
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] NUTS versions in Stan
parts:
I think they're all alive, in varying degrees.
adaptive_sampler.hpp: Class definition for samplers that tune (e.g.) a step size parameter online.
nuts.hpp: NUTS.
adaptive_hmc.hpp: HMC with autotuning for step sizes.
adaptive_cdhmc.hpp: HMC with autotuning for step sizes, where you specify the trajectory length as epsilon*L.
dualaverage.hpp: Used to tune step sizes by the three samplers above.

Matt
